subject: Portal credentialing scope exception & SSO proof escalation
messages:
From: Aisha Ramesh <aisha.r@brightwave.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: portal-admin@vendr.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding - SSO proof and scope exception

Hi Sean,

Quick follow-up from our security intake: we need a short exception to the standard portal scoping for one of our integrations. BrightWave is insisting on connecting via a delegated service account that requires preservation of an existing SSO identity mapping (we can't rekey in the current window). Their procurement team flagged that this will expand data-access surface and asked for: 1) SOC 2 extract showing control mapping for service accounts, 2) a short proof that the portal supports SSO assertions tied to an external IdP (with sample assertion headers), and 3) confirmation of the least-privilege role we'll map in Vendr for upload-only.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an archived SOC2 extract (pdf is fine) and a small SSO assertion sample? BrightWave would like to keep the onboarding on this week. I copied Vendr portal-admin to see if there are any immediate manifest constraints on their side.

Thanks,
Aisha Ramesh
Security Program Manager
BrightWave Inc

Attachment: brightwave-soc2-request-template.docx (referenced)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Ramesh <aisha.r@brightwave.com>, portal-admin@vendr.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding - SSO proof and scope exception

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a SOC 2 extract (redacted) and an example SAML assertion snippet for the delegated service account flow. Two notes: 1) the SOC2 extract will be a control-mapping PDF (we'll redact customer-specific items), and 2) Vendr's portal role model currently doesn't offer a native "upload-only" permission for service accounts — we'll likely propose a constrained "Uploader" role with restricted bucket prefixes.

Ben, Kim — looping you both to coordinate artifacts and the vendr role mapping. Ben, can you pull the latest SOC2 extract and highlight the control families that cover service account credentialing and KMS usage? Kim, can you confirm whether we have the SAML assertion example (signed with our staging cert) and whether the Vendr role mapping CSV can be produced for the account in question?

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan once we know timelines. Aisha — we'll aim to get the artifacts to you today or early Monday at the latest.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: internal checklist: vendr-onboard-checklist.md

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding - SSO proof and scope exception

Sean / Kim —

I grabbed the SOC2 extract from our security drive and created a redacted PDF focusing on relevant sections for service account controls (A2, CC5, and KMS rotation notes). See attached: brightwave-soc2-extract-2026.pdf. I also exported the Vendr role definitions we currently use and put them in vendr-account-role-matrix.csv — it shows permissions by role and allowed S3 prefixes. For BrightWave's request, the closest fit is the "Uploader" pattern in the CSV (write-only on /brightwave/uploads/*).

Notes:
- The SOC2 extract explicitly references our key management (rotation) under CC5, but it does not include customer-specific logs.
- The SAML assertion sample is in our staging key vault; Kim, if you can sign off, please produce a copy (sanitized) and we'll hand it to BrightWave.

Ben
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightwave-soc2-extract-2026.pdf; vendr-account-role-matrix.csv

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Ramesh <aisha.r@brightwave.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: portal-admin@vendr.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding - SSO proof and scope exception

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the patience. Per internal review: we can provide a sanitized SAML assertion example (signed with staging cert) and the redacted SOC2 extract Ben attached. For the Vendr role, we propose the following narrow scope for the service account: role = "Uploader-Scoped", allowed actions = PutObject, ListBucket (limited), allowed prefixes = /brightwave/uploads/*, retention = 30 days; we will add a policy that denies DeleteObject unless a CRC flag is set and a documented exception is approved.

Portal-admin@vendr.com — can you confirm whether Vendr can accept the assertion with the given prefix restrictions and whether they need any additional metadata on the service account (owner email, key thumbprint)? If Vendr requires a custom role, please provide the role template so we can map to our CSV and return a signed manifest (vendr-account-role-matrix.csv updated).

Action items:
- Sean: confirm BrightWave is ok with the proposed uploader-scoped role and the 30d retention.
- Ben: please add a one-line note in the SOC2 extract PDF about the policy deny-delete exception path (so audit reviewers have a trace).
- Vendr: confirm acceptance or provide role template.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none — uploaded manifest link will follow)
